description: This file contains utility functions for generating CSV representations of commit data, including header creation, entity-to-CSV row conversion, and quoting values.

methods.name: CommitCSVHeader
methods.description: Returns the CSV header row for commit data

methods.name: CommitEntityToCSVRow
methods.description: Converts a commit entity to a CSV row

methods.name: CommitEntitiesToCSVRows
methods.description: Converts a list of commit entities to CSV rows

methods.name: quoteAll
methods.description: Quotes all strings in a slice for CSV formatting
